_notes: Toll of the Flock (relics.json vfx, one travelling layer): three ghost sheep
galloping right, drawn on black, so keyed by luminance (keyed: true). Six cells
on a 3x2 grid of 512px, played once in order across the flight: f0-f4 are the
gallop, f5 is the flock coming apart into motes, which is why the layer is
`until: once` with `seconds` 0.75 past a 0.55s travel -- the dissolve lands on
the target rather than looping mid-air. No sequence: the cells are the frames.
Wisps in f1 and f2 reach the cell's right and left edges; at the 340px box
they are a pixel or two of trail and were left. Replayed byte-identical
